notes: Expected items follow docs/INTERFACES.md "Project explorer": id = `${element}:${identity}` (#2 for duplicates in document order), group from the classification table, status from the default view (CDATA bodies when present, else the element lines). `detail` null = unspecified by the contract. EntityEndpoint identity is its Name attribute; the app may also show Version. Items are sorted by group order, then name. Line ranges are 1-based inclusive.
